title: Comma in module name leads to System.InvalidOperationException : Could not look up type

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: A fault in an existing feature

body:
Given the following tests:

```
module Facts

open Xunit

module ``nested module with a , in the name`` =  // the comma is the problem here
    [<Fact>]
    let fact () = ()
```

and the following package references (not important but for completness):
```
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk" Version="17.14.1" />
<PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="2.0.3" />
<PackageReference Include="xunit.runner.visualstudio" Version="3.1.1" />
```

The tests run successfully within Rider, but they fail when running `dotnet test <fsproj>` with the following error message:

 ```
dotnet test .\XunitFsharpRepro\XunitFsharpRepro.fsproj
Restore complete (0.2s)
  XunitFsharpRepro succeeded (1.2s) → XunitFsharpRepro\bin\Debug\net9.0\XunitFsharpRepro.dll
[xUnit.net 00:00:00.00] xUnit.net VSTest Adapter v3.1.1+bf6400fd51 (64-bit .NET 9.0.6)
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.43]   Discovering: XunitFsharpRepro
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.54]   Discovered:  XunitFsharpRepro
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.63]     [FATAL ERROR] System.InvalidOperationException
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.63]       System.InvalidOperationException : Could not look up type Facts+nested module with a \, in the name, XunitFsharpRepro, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.64]       Stack Trace:
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.64]            at System.Linq.Enumerable.ListSelectIterator`2.MoveNext()
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.64]            at System.Linq.Enumerable.IEnumerableWhereIterator`1.ToArray()
[xUnit.net 00:00:01.64] Catastrophic failure: System.InvalidOperationException : Could not look up type Facts+nested module with a \, in the name, XunitFsharpRepro, Version=1.0.0.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null
[xUnit.net 00:00:06.63]   Starting:    XunitFsharpRepro
[xUnit.net 00:00:06.63]     [FATAL ERROR] Xunit.Sdk.TestPipelineException
[xUnit.net 00:00:06.63]       Test process crashed with exit code 1.
[xUnit.net 00:00:06.63] Catastrophic failure: Test process crashed with exit code 1.
[xUnit.net 00:00:06.64]   Finished:    XunitFsharpRepro
Additionally, path to test adapters can be specified using /TestAdapterPath command. Example  /TestAdapterPath:<pathToCustomAdapters>.
  XunitFsharpRepro test failed with 1 error(s) and 1 warning(s) (7.2s)
    C:\Program Files\dotnet\sdk\9.0.301\Microsoft.TestPlatform.targets(48,5): warning : No test is available in C:\Projects\XunitFsharpRepro\XunitFsharpRepro\bin\Debug\net9.0\XunitFsharpRepro.dll. Make sure that test discoverer & executors are registered and platform & framework version settings are appropriate and try again.
    C:\Program Files\dotnet\sdk\9.0.301\Microsoft.TestPlatform.targets(48,5): error MSB6006: "dotnet.exe" exited with code 1.

Test summary: total: 0, failed: 0, succeeded: 0, skipped: 0, duration: 7.2s
Build failed with 1 error(s) and 1 warning(s) in 8.8s
```

The problem is the comma in the name.


Thank you for your fantastic work on xUnit!
